title: Capping Assay: Steps 3-6
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Pre‑load magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Load 100 µL of beads in buffer onto the magnetic module positioned in a NEST 96‑deepwell plate before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Map extraction to elution wells
steps.instruction: Map each well of the magnetic extraction plate (slot 4) directly to the corresponding well of the elution PCR plate (slot 1): A1→A1, B1→B1, …, D2→D2.

steps.title: Configure tip‑tracking option
steps.instruction: Set the ‘track tips across protocol runs’ parameter to ‘yes’ to continue tip usage from the previous run, or to ‘no’ to start from column 1 of the first tiprack.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol files and unzip them if they are compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware (magnetic module, temperature module, tip racks, plates) as indicated by the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Perform calibration of all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration workflow.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the automated extraction.
